Title: Azure Container Registry now available in Norway East region

Body.Content:
Azure Container Registry is now generally available in the Norway East region. Azure Container Registry allows you to build, store, and manage images and artifacts for all types of container deployments.

To learn more, read the Container Registry product page and documentation.

See the list of all regions where Azure Container Registry is available and where it's coming next.
